items.en: Iran says joint statement with Oman on Hormuz is in its final stage.

items.en: Multiple people killed in mass shooting in North Carolina, US.

items.en: Israeli forces raid Qalandia refugee camp near Jerusalem, detaining a woman.

items.en: IDF began attacking targets in Lebanon; Israeli officials blame Hezbollah.
